remarks:
Enjoy the comfort and simplicity of country living at 7781 Farrington Hollow Road in Cherry Creek, NY. Nestled in a peaceful rural setting, this completely renovated inviting two-bedroom, one-bath home offers a wonderful opportunity for those seeking a quiet countryside recreational retreat or a comfortable year-round residence.
The home features several recent improvements, including a new metal roof, updated vinyl windows, siding, and a beautifully renovated bathroom and walk in pantry. Additional updates include kitchen appliances approximately three years old, adding convenience and functionality to everyday living. A private well provides the home's water supply, while a single-car garage offers convenient parking and additional storage.
One of the property's most appealing features is its beautiful side yard, shaded by towering mature maple trees that create a peaceful, park-like atmosphere. Imagine relaxing outdoors on warm summer afternoons, enjoying the gentle breeze beneath the trees, or gathering with friends in this inviting country setting.
Outdoor enthusiasts will enjoy the spring and fall benefit of being merely 2.5 miles from the Boutwell State forest and Canadaway Creek Wildlife management unit for deer and turkey hunting pursuits. And winter fans will enjoy access to the Chautauqua County snowmobile trail (#C1C) only 1,200 feet away. 
Surrounded by the natural beauty of rural Chautauqua County, this property offers the charm of country living with the benefit of several important updates already completed. Whether you're looking for a weekend getaway, or a simpler lifestyle away making it a full-time residence, , this charming country home is ready for its next chapter.
